# karagoz-anim

> Script + voice → 2D limited animation, produced by a team of AI agents on Meta's models.

karagoz-anim turns a script and voice lines into a 2D limited-animation scene (flat colour, black outline,
1920×1080, 24 fps). Studio agents write small YAML/JSON files with names, never x/y coordinates; a coordinate
engine turns names into positions, scale, frames and face patches; drawings come from Muse Image, masks from
SAM 3.1, vision checks from Muse Spark, voices from ElevenLabs.
